curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42059-1-1.pdf (the truck is steps 1-52, the ramp steps 53-55; page 47 shows the truck pulled back and launched at the ramp; the back cover's 42058 + 42059 model is a different build)

functions.does: Pull the truck back and let go: the pull-back motor at the back turns the rear axle, a 12 long axle straight through it carrying both rear wheels, and the truck races forward.
functions.source: book: steps 1 and 11 (the pull-back motor and the axle through it), 52 (the wheels), page 47 (the hand pulling it back, the arrow forward)
functions.note: the pull-back motor's spring is what drives it; turning a rear wheel by hand turns the other rear wheel and the motor's shaft with it

functions.does: The pull-back motor's spring winds up as the truck is pulled back and drives it forward when let go.
functions.skip: a spring only matters under force

functions.does: The front wheels roll freely, both on one 12 long axle; there's no steering.
The stunt ramp, a printed cardboard sheet folded over two 9 long beams, stands on the ground for the truck to jump off.
